# Capabilities in delfin/agent/ that the PRODUCT does not reach.
#
# Written by tests/test_every_capability_has_a_caller.py, which refuses a
# name that is not in here. Columns: tier, name, where it is defined.
#
# tier "nowhere"   -- nothing in delfin/ or tests/ names it at all. Dead
#                     code, or a capability that was never connected.
# tier "test-only" -- only the suite reaches it. The capability exists and
#                     is proven, and nothing in the running product uses
#                     it.
#
# A name LEAVES this list by being connected or deleted, and the test then
# requires the list to be shortened: the count only goes down. Adding a
# line is a deliberate act and belongs in a pull request of its own, with
# the reason.
#
# Measured 2026-11-20, by the functions in that test file, so the list
# and the check cannot compute it differently.

nowhere	controller_hint	delfin/agent/loop_commands.py:298

# for_files (verify_recipe.py:327) KEPT as test-only 2026-11-22, measured:
# zero product callers. The product consumers of verify_recipe hold a
# recipe but never a changed-file list -- prompt_loader.py:1002-1003 calls
# discover+render, evidence.py:203 calls discover -- so narrowing a recipe
# to changed files (for_files) is unreachable by construction today.
# Deciding WHICH consumer would gain a changed-file list is a design
# decision, not a repair; wiring one arbitrarily would mount a call on a
# path that runs but does not need it. Revisit if a consumer starts
# holding both a recipe and a diff.

# NOT removed 2026-11-22 (wave 36 r4, then re-measured at the GATE, not
# at the predicate): is_safe is not redundant, but the predicate numbers
# r4 reported overstate what the product does, and both measurements are
# recorded here because the difference between them is the lesson.
#
# At the predicate (KitToolPermissions.matches_bash_auto_allow,
# api_client.py:11109), default mode: 8 commands are auto-allowed that
# is_safe refuses -- ls > f, ls 3>f, ls >&f, ls &>f, cat <>f,
# sort --out=f x, sort --compress-program=sh x, git reflog expire --all.
#
# At the gate (_run_permission_gate, the entry a bash call really takes,
# which consults the predicate only after the deny list, the secret scan,
# the approval guard, the irreversibility rule and unrestorable.refusal):
# git reflog expire --expire=now --all ASKS, and echo x >
# ~/.ssh/authorized_keys is refused outright (secret-deny). What runs
# unasked is the redirect family inside the workspace -- which is
# deliberate policy, documented in matches_bash_auto_allow itself, and
# confined by the cage -- plus two classes that are not:
#   * a redirect whose TARGET is outside the workspace
#     (echo x > ~/.bashrc, ls > /tmp/elsewhere.txt, ls > ../escape.txt:
#     RUN, no question; _changes_outside_the_workspace does not read
#     redirection targets at all),
#   * a flag that runs a program (sort --compress-program=sh x and the
#     space form: RUN, no question).
# Controls at the gate: ls -la, git status, cat f, grep x f, grep -r,
# python3 --version, pytest all RUN; rm -rf f and git push --force are
# refused by deny-pattern; curl -T asks.
#
# So a blanket veto on is_safe would be wrong: at the predicate it also
# refuses grep -r, sed -n, awk, find, python3 --version, pytest, mkdir
# and touch, which the list grants on purpose. The repair is the two
# classes above, in api_client.py, which the self-modification guard
# refuses to an unattended session. Kept until that attended change
# lands; deleting the row would discard a judgement the gate still needs.
test-only	is_safe	delfin/agent/readonly_pipeline.py:371
test-only	keyed_engines_configured	delfin/agent/web_tools.py:698
test-only	map_to_host	delfin/agent/shared_tmp.py:207
test-only	pdf_xfa_data	delfin/agent/office.py:3514
test-only	quality_report	delfin/agent/compaction_quality.py:75
# NOT removed 2026-11-22 (wave 36 r4): the product's per-turn reset is
# begin_figure_turn (office.py:6070, driven by engine.py:3482), which opens
# a NEW token'd scope and pops only that token -- it cannot clear an
# existing scope on demand, and eviction (office.py:6051) only trims stale
# scopes. No product path is equivalent to an explicit clear; the office
# tool runs are the consumers and keep needing it between turns.
